sources.note: This work describes Present Great Andamanese (PGA), a koine of the northern varieties Jero (Aka-Jeru), Sare (Aka-Cari), Khora and Bo, compared with Onge and Jarawa. The paper's only phonological content is the segmental inventory (vowels, consonants, free variation, unshared sounds) of Present Great Andamanese versus Onge and Jarawa. The words stress, accent, tone, pitch, prosody, intonation and syllable do not occur anywhere in the 22-page text. Aka-Jeru is named only as one of the ten constituent varieties of the Great Andamanese continuum (printed p. 793, Fig. 2) and as a source of the PGA…

tone.quote: Thirty-one phonemes have been set up for the Andamanese language [as it is spoken by the present Great Andamanese], of which twenty-eight are segmental phonemes; the remaining three being supra-segmental phonemes. [...] Andamanese language has the following supra-segmental features. 1] Length 2] Accent 3] Juncture 4] Intonation and out of these four features, intonation, does not play any significant role, i.e., it is phonetic in character and not phonemic. [...] In Andamanese language, the syllable preceeding the final syllable is accented to differentiate the meaning of a statement type from a question or doubtfulness. It is found at sentence level.
tone.locator: ch. II 'Phonology': p. 35 (opening paragraph) and sec. 2.3 'Suprasegmental features' pp. 82-83 incl. 2.3.2 'Accent'; pp. 82-83 checked
tone.summary: No tone: the only suprasegmental phonemes are vowel length, a sentence-level accent and juncture; intonation phonetic only (implicit no-tone by exhaustive listing, Present Great Andamanese, 1970s Strait Island speech).

sources.note: The only fieldwork-based reference grammar (with audio) of the one variety of this languoid that was ever recorded phonetically (PGA = mixe1288 under akaj1239); our classification rests on a single hedged family-wide sentence in a grammar of colonial-era fragments whose sources did not mark stress. If ch. II states a stress rule it either confirms root-initial stress with examples (upgrade) or refines/contradicts it (Manoharan 1989 and Gordon 2002 had 'penult' for this variety).
